documents.text: Welcome to our Frequently Asked Questions. Regarding cancellations, please note that cancelling before the cutoff still retains a mandatory administration charge of 27 euros. For late arrivals, a guest reaching reception at 01:30 cannot check in unless they obtained permission before arriving. Our onsite swimming pool is a premium facility; the accommodation charges booked guests 19 euros to enter it, in addition to their holiday price. Finally, regarding activities, the amount quoted covers accommodation only. Taking a hike with a guide requires a separate 38 euro payment. We hope this clarifies your upcoming stay.

Agent: Hello, how can I help? Guest: I need details on the Alder offer. Agent: Certainly. For refunds, neither the payment returned nor the method of refund for cancellation is documented. However, under the unbooked offer policy, before the cancellation cutoff the entire payment is returned as money, with no deduction. Regarding arrival, 01:30 registration is available automatically, without any earlier contact or request. A swimming area is mentioned but its location, price and booking access conditions are not stated. As for activities, neither the activity itinerary nor any statement about a guided walk being included in the amount quoted is supplied. Note that the Distractor belongs to a different, unselected Birch offer.

Activities: The amount quoted pays for a walking excursion on a trail accompanied by a human guide, with nothing further to pay. Scope confirmed for current selection.

Package Comparison Extract: Refund policies present a conflict. Two equally current and authoritative policies disagree. Neither overrides the other. Applicable terms are unresolved. One policy states: Before the cancellation cutoff the entire payment is returned as money, with no deduction. The other states: Cancelling before the cutoff still retains a mandatory administration charge of 27 euros. Arrival rules are silent; no rules address overnight registration or whether prior contact is necessary. Facility details confirm the booked accommodation has an operational swimming pool on its premises, available during the stay without any separate fee. Activity terms clarify the amount quoted covers accommodation only; taking a hike with a guide requires a separate 38 euro payment.
